days.shot: Your first look at the fair

rows.title: Land
rows.desc: MIA or FLL. MIA is about 20 minutes from the house and FLL about 40–50. We’ll share Ubers from each airport.

rows.title: Here early?
rows.desc: Rest at the house, or walk around the Design District. Nothing is planned until dinner.

rows.title: Late dinner: Mangrove or Thai in
rows.desc: Mangrove is Jamaican food and a cocktail bar downtown, 103 NW 1st Ave. The kitchen is open until 11:45 on Fridays. Or we order Thai and eat at the house. We’ll decide on the day.

rows.title: Out, if you still have energy
rows.desc: unKommon Art Week at Little River Studios is a few blocks from the house. Tickets on DICE.

rows.title: Breakfast at Libertino Cafe
rows.desc: Wynwood, 2659 NW 2nd Ave. Good coffee, milk bread sandwiches and waffles. A slow start.

rows.title: Galleries
rows.desc: Wynwood and the Design District. ICA Miami is free. Superblue is $42 if you want it. Book a time.

rows.title: Water taxi to the fair
rows.desc: Free. Boats leave the Venetian Marina, 1635 N Bayshore Dr, every 7–9 minutes for Maurice Gibb Park in Miami Beach. A free shuttle goes from there to the fair.

rows.title: Art Basel Miami Beach
rows.desc: Miami Beach Convention Center, open until 6. Day ticket $92. This is the only ticket we need.

rows.title: Home to get ready
rows.desc: Water taxi back, or a shared ride.

rows.title: Dinner, to be decided
rows.desc: Somewhere special, or somewhere affordable. We’ll choose closer to the date.

rows.title: Everyday People
rows.desc: The Art Week party. The 2026 date isn’t out yet. Last year it was on Saturday and cost $35.

rows.title: VOUS Church
rows.desc: Design District, 77 NE 40th St. Services at 10 and 12.

rows.title: Matcha at Bigface
rows.desc: 40 NE 40th St, across the street.

rows.title: Wynwood Walls
rows.desc: About $12–15, and an hour is plenty.

rows.title: Casa Neos
rows.desc: The day party, on the Miami River. About $100–150 each. Flying home today? Pack in the morning and go to the airport from here. Book.

rows.title: Takeout at the house
rows.desc: For anyone still here. Everyone pays for their own.

days.shot: The last view before you fly

rows.title: Coffee, then pack
rows.desc: Check out by 11, time to confirm with the host. Bags come with us.

rows.title: Work from Miami
rows.desc: A coworking space in Wynwood or a café with good Wi-Fi. We’ll pick one closer to the date.

rows.title: Or take the day
rows.desc: A last swim, anything we missed, or a long lunch.

rows.title: Beach club, if we want it
rows.desc: Nikki Beach or Joia Beach, about $100–150 each. Only if enough people want it and it fits the budget. Tell me in the RSVP.

rows.title: Airport
rows.desc: For flights around 9. Leave extra time for FLL.
